title: 18_6369445_General_1948_Vol_1
doc_notes: This document is a collection of military correspondence and routing slips regarding the reporting and investigation of 'Flying Discs' and Project SIGN, containing reports of specific sightings.

encounters.summary: Four witnesses observed a round, phosphorescent object with a phosphorescent trail moving at great speed at an altitude of 6 to 8 miles.
encounters.quote: round, phosphorescent... Great amount of speed

encounters.summary: Witnesses reported two objects falling to earth resembling aircraft with smoke and debris trailing.
encounters.quote: Description of objects similar to falling aircraft with smoke and debris trailing.

encounters.summary: Witness reported two objects falling to earth north of Bakersfield, one appearing to be on fire with red and black smoke trailing.
encounters.quote: One object seemed to be on fire with red and black smoke trailing behind.
